parole.significato: Myzeqe (a geographic region and plain of the Western Lowlands, Albania)
parole.testo: A development of medieval Albanian Muzaka, likely through Italian Musacchia, though the ultimate origin of the name is unclear: * A local Albanian derivation would be from Albanian mëzak (“young calf”); * Johan Georg Von Hahn derived it from Illyrian; * Gjon Muzaka from Ancient Greek Μολοσσοί (Molos
